name: Blog Link Hover Preview
author: Arun Paul

sections.description:
Blog Link Hover Preview adds Wikipedia-style hover popups to internal blog links inside post content only.

When users hover over an internal post link, a clean popup appears showing:

  • Post title
  • Short excerpt
  • Read more link

The popup automatically adjusts its position on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Features

  • Wikipedia-style hover preview
  • Works only inside blog content
  • Smart auto positioning
  • Mobile responsive
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No header or footer interference
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Add internal blog links inside post content
  4. Hover and see the preview
sections.faq:
Does it work on mobile?

Yes. Tap shows preview and adapts automatically.

Does it work on external links?

No. Only internal blog post links.
